composers_checked.name: Pleyel, Ignaz
composers_checked.note: Gap check against Benton numbers in Artaria, Hungaroton and IPG catalogues: added Oboe Quartets B. 391 and B. 394 (not on IMSLP). No recordings found of the late trios B. 443–476 or of B. 382–385. B. 428 is Hob. XV:3, recorded under Haydn's name; B. 429 (Hob. XV:4) has a Henle edition but no recording or performance found.

note: Trios B. 431–436 are printed "flute (or violin)"; listed as piano trios with a flute alternative because all three commercial recordings use violin. Several floors rest on CDs of the Internationale Ignaz Pleyel Gesellschaft (IPG, pleyel.at), mostly live concert recordings. Septet B. 251 kept at low confidence (Amadeus 2011 edition; an IPG septet CD that does not name the work). For c19: Hungaroton 2013 "Flute Quartets Ben 319–324" (Németh, Vitárius) are flute versions of the String Quartets B. 319–324; the wind Sextet B. 283 (Consortium Classicum) has no strings. Not checked: the Hungaroton HCD 32572 booklet and IPG booklets (performers of IPG-CD 47). BY HAND (orchestrating session, 2026-10-17, on the owner's instruction to leave off lesser-known works that raise flags): 1 work(s) the agent kept at low confidence were moved to skipped (reason "doubtful") and parked in data/chamber/curation/parked-low-confidence.json: Pleyel: Septet in E-flat major, B. 251.
